documents.title: Phillips County 2026 budget, as filed with the state
documents.note: Posted on the Arkansas Transparency portal (artransparency.gov) in May 2026. 13 pages. Amounts are the Appropriated budget amounts in Section 5 (General Fund 'Appropriated Budgets Amounts'; other funds' category lines and 'Total ... Fund' lines). Not the projected revenue or the 90% 'Allowed Budgeted Amount' cap, except where they are the same number. column. The document is a scan; it was read with optical character recognition, and every parent total was checked against its parts.
